scope: Persistent draft submission intent, resumable asset mapping, local deduplication, unknown-outcome protection, and draft-only channel adapter

red_evidence.reason: the persistent submission behavior was not implemented and all four initial behavior assertions failed

assertions: the submission identity is durable before the first remote asset request
successfully uploaded assets are mapped immutably and reused after a later asset failure
a possibly successful draft timeout becomes unknown and is never blindly retried
a successful repeated submit returns the stored draft identity without another remote call
bundle and account identity conflicts are rejected by durable storage
the channel adapter exposes asset upload and draft creation only, with no publish action

review.kind: separate primary-agent review because delegated review is disabled by session policy

live_blocker: The user authorized skipping the external account, so no real asset upload or draft identity exists.
